lines.text: What if your job was wiping the King of England's bottom?
You're Henry the Eighth's Groom of the Stool. A real job.
Gross? Yes. But nobody else gets the King alone. Every single day.
Put in a good word for me?
lines.speaker: lord

lines.text: So lords bribe you for a word in his ear. You get rich. You get knighted.
Then the King turns on his wife, Anne Boleyn. And he needs men to blame.
Your best friend, the King, sends you to the axe.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.
